agender.definition: Someone who does not identify with or experience any gender.
agender.name: Agender

androgynous.definition: Someone with a combination of masculine and feminine traits.
androgynous.name: Androgynous

bigender.definition: Someone who experiences two gender identities.
bigender.name: Bigender

cis_man.definition: A man whose gender identity matches his sex assigned at birth.
cis_man.name: Cis Man

cis_woman.definition: A woman whose gender identity matches her sex assigned at birth.
cis_woman.name: Cis Woman

gender_nonconforming.definition: Someone who does not subscribe to societal gender expectations or norms.
gender_nonconforming.name: Gender Nonconforming

genderfluid.definition: Someone whose gender varies over time.
genderfluid.name: Genderfluid

genderqueer.definition: Someone whose gender falls outside of the traditional gender binary.
genderqueer.name: Genderqueer

hijra.definition: A third gender in South Asian cultures.
hijra.name: Hijra

intersex.definition: Someone born with sex characteristics that do not fit the typical definitions of male or female bodies.
intersex.name: Intersex

nonbinary.definition: Someone whose gender falls outside the gender binary.
nonbinary.name: Non-binary

pangender.definition: Someone who identifies with multiple or all genders.
pangender.name: Pangender

trans_man.definition: A man who was assigned female at birth.
trans_man.name: Trans Man

trans_woman.definition: A woman who was assigned male at birth.
trans_woman.name: Trans Woman

transfeminine.definition: Someone with a feminine gender identity who was assigned male at birth.
transfeminine.name: Transfeminine

transgender.definition: Someone whose gender identity does not match their sex assigned at birth.
transgender.name: Transgender

transmasculine.definition: Someone with a masculine gender identity who was assigned female at birth.
transmasculine.name: Transmasculine

two_spirit.definition: A third gender in Indigenous North American cultures.
two_spirit.name: Two Spirit
